info.title: SYNTHORA News Sentiment Oracle
info.description: Real-time news sentiment scoring via GDELT 2.0 Timeline Tone API. Analyze sentiment for any crypto asset, macro topic, or financial keyword across global news. Returns tone score and directional signal.
info.x-guidance: POST /service with JSON body {"input": "bitcoin"} where input is any search keyword. Returns: tone_score (-100 to +100), signal (bearish/neutral/bullish), article_count.
x-use-cases: get current news sentiment for Bitcoin or Ethereum
analyze media tone for a macro topic like interest rates
measure news sentiment shift before an earnings event
feed crypto news sentiment into an AI trading strategy
check if news is bullish or bearish for a specific token
monitor sentiment trend for DeFi protocols in the media
get a real-time news mood score for any financial keyword
use GDELT sentiment as a contrarian signal in a portfolio
compare sentiment scores across different asset classes
track how media coverage of a DAO or protocol changes over time
